pages.title: Inertia Damper
pages.text: A device that cancels momentum locally, letting a ship accelerate without crushing everything inside. Negative mass offsets positive mass and a superconducting coil steers the balance. It is quiet and cool, and objects placed on it never slide off.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Accelerating anything quickly kills everyone on board. In the Higgs Field Modulator, a Negative Mass Ingot balanced against the passenger's mass, and the coil adjusted it. Every starship needs one.
